description.en-US: This is the official F-Droid repository for Klas Holmgren's Android apps, including KeyMatch, mooves, NumBlocks, and Echoes of Elysium.

summary.en-US: A challenging number placement puzzle game.

description.en-US:
NumBlocks is a number placement puzzle game. Fill each region with
the digits 1 through the region's size so that no number repeats in
a region or among adjacent cells.

Play through staged puzzles at Easy, Medium, and Hard, or generate
new levels. Works offline. No account required.
